File.label: Open Next
File.title: Open the next image file in the folder of the current image

File.label: Open Previous
File.title: Open the previous image file in the folder of the current image

File.label: New…
File.title: Create a blank image (optionally pre-filled with a ramp, gradient, checkerboard, sine grating or noise).

File.label: New from System Clipboard
File.title: Open the image on the system clipboard as a new image (press ⌘V in the viewport when the browser cannot read it directly)

File.label: Print…
File.title: Print the current view with its name, size, calibration and a scale bar

File.label: New ▸ Internal Clipboard…
File.title: Open the internal clipboard (the pixels copied with Edit ▸ Copy / Cut) as a new image; a non-rectangular copy becomes its selection.

File.label: Open Recent…
File.title: Re-open one of the recently opened files (newest first).

File.label: Revert
File.title: Reload the image from disk, discarding all changes.

Edit.label: Cut
Edit.title: Copy the selection (all channels of the current plane) to the internal clipboard and clear it to the background value.

Edit.label: Copy
Edit.title: Copy the selection's pixels (all channels of the current plane) to the internal clipboard.

Edit.label: Copy to System
Edit.title: Copy the current view (or the selection's bounding box) to the system clipboard as PNG

Edit.label: Paste
Edit.title: Paste the clipboard into the current plane, at the selection (or centred).

Edit.label: Set Foreground Value…
Edit.title: Set only the foreground value (used by the value-picker tool); the background value is left unchanged.

Edit.label: Set Background Value…
Edit.title: Set only the background value (used by the value-picker tool with Alt); the foreground value is left unchanged.

Edit.label: Fill…
Edit.title: Fill the selection with the foreground value.

Edit.label: Clear
Edit.title: Set the selection to the background value.

Edit.label: Clear Outside
Edit.title: Set everything outside the selection to the background value.

Edit.label: Draw…
Edit.title: Burn the selection outline into the pixels.

Edit.label: Paste Control…
Edit.title: Set how Paste combines the clipboard with the image (ImageJ's Paste Control transfer modes).

Edit.label: Paste (with transfer mode)…
Edit.title: Paste the clipboard into the current plane (at the selection, or centred) combining it with the pixels using the Paste Control transfer mode.

Edit.label: Paint Stroke…
Edit.title: Burn a brush stroke (polyline with round caps) into the current plane using the foreground value. Used by the brush tool.

Edit.label: Flood Fill…
Edit.title: Fill the connected region of similar pixels around a point with the foreground value (the bucket tool).

Image.label: Crop
Image.title: Crop the whole stack to the bounding box of the selection.

Image.label: Duplicate…
Image.title: Copy the image (or the current plane / channel) into a new tab.

Image.label: Scale…
Image.title: Resize by factors (or to a target size) with interpolation; updates the calibration.

Image.label: Rotate…
Image.title: Rotate by an arbitrary angle (degrees, clockwise positive).

Image.label: Properties / Set Scale…
Image.title: Set the spatial / temporal calibration of the image.

Image.label: Set Scale from Line…
Image.title: Calibrate using a line selection of known length.

Process.label: Image Calculator…
Process.title: Pixel-wise arithmetic between two images: result = image1 ⊕ image2.

Process.label: Enhance Contrast…
Process.title: Stretch the display range (or the pixel values) so a given fraction of pixels saturate; optionally equalize the histogram.

Process.label: Subtract Background…
Process.title: Rolling-ball (or sliding paraboloid / top-hat) background subtraction.

Process.label: Shadows…
Process.title: Emboss-like relief with light coming from the chosen direction.

Process.label: Retinex…
Process.title: Multi-scale retinex with colour restoration (MSRCR) – compresses the dynamic range and enhances local contrast; grayscale images use plain multi-scale retinex (Fiji's Retinex).

Analyze.label: Analyze Skeleton…
Analyze.title: Fiji's Analyze Skeleton: tag the pixels of a binary skeleton (end points, slabs, junctions), trace its branches and report branches, junctions, end points and branch lengths per skeleton plus a Branches table; per plane (2D) or on the whole z-stack (3D).

Analyze.label: Skeleton Longest Shortest Path…
Analyze.title: Binary mask of the longest shortest path of every skeleton (Fiji's Analyze Skeleton 'longest shortest path': the longest of all shortest vertex-to-vertex paths); the Results and Branches tables are filled as by Analyze Skeleton.

Analyze.label: Colocalization (Costes)…
Analyze.title: Coloc 2-style colocalization of two channels within the selection: Costes automatic thresholds (orthogonal regression), Pearson (whole and above thresholds), thresholded Manders tM1/tM2, Spearman and the Costes block-scrambling significance test.

Analyze.label: Measure
Analyze.title: Measure the selection (or the whole plane) and append a row to the Results table (on the 'Redirect to' image of Set Measurements when one is set).

Analyze.label: Measure Stack…
Analyze.title: Measure the selection on every slice / frame of the current channel.

Analyze.label: Set Measurements…
Analyze.title: Choose which columns Measure and Analyze Particles report, and how coordinates and labels are reported.

Analyze.label: Clear Results
Analyze.title: Empty the Results table.

Analyze.label: Analyze Particles…
Analyze.title: Find connected objects in a binary (or thresholded) image, filter them by size and circularity, measure them, and add outlines to the ROI manager.

Analyze.label: Histogram…
Analyze.title: Histogram of the current plane (or selection) with statistics – ImageJ's Histogram dialog: bins, fixed X range, fixed Y max, log scale, stack histogram, list to Results.

Analyze.label: Plot Profile…
Analyze.title: Intensity profile along a line, or column/row averages of a rectangle.

Analyze.label: Find Maxima…
Analyze.title: Local maxima with a prominence (noise tolerance) criterion, like ImageJ's Find Maxima.

Analyze.label: Summarize Results…
Analyze.title: Mean, SD, min and max of every numeric Results column (optionally per group of a label column).

Analyze.label: Measure Labels…
Analyze.title: Measure every object of a label image (as produced by Label Connected Components).

Analyze.label: Colocalization (2 channels)…
Analyze.title: Pearson, Spearman and Manders coefficients between two channels (within the selection).

Analyze.label: Distribution…
Analyze.title: Histogram of a Results-table column (ImageJ Analyze ▸ Distribution: automatic binning or a fixed number of bins and range).

Analyze.label: Calibrate (intensity)…
Analyze.title: Fit a function mapping pixel values to known standards (density calibration); Measure Calibrated then reports calibrated Mean/Min/Max.

Analyze.label: Calibrated Values (32-bit)
Analyze.title: New 32-bit image whose pixels are the calibrated values (after Analyze ▸ Calibrate) of this image.

Analyze.label: Measure (calibrated values)
Analyze.title: Measure like Measure, but with Mean / StdDev / Min / Max / Median / Mode / IntDen (and Skew, Kurt, XM, YM) computed from the calibrated pixel values (Analyze ▸ Calibrate); RawIntDen stays raw, like ImageJ.

Analyze.label: Angle
Analyze.title: Angle of a line selection (degrees, counter-clockwise), or the angle at the vertex of a 3-point segmented line (the angle tool).

Analyze.label: Curve Fitting…
Analyze.title: Least-squares fit of x/y data (two Results columns, the last plot, or typed values) to a line, polynomial, exponential, power, log, Gaussian, error function, sigmoid, Rodbard, rational, Michaelis-Menten … or a user-defined equation (ImageJ CurveFitter parity).

Analyze.label: Fractal Box Count…
Analyze.title: Box-counting fractal dimension of the binary (or thresholded) current plane: slope of log(count) vs log(1/size).

Analyze.label: Surface Plot…
Analyze.title: 3-D surface rendering of the current plane (or the selection) as a new RGB image.

Analyze.label: Stack Histogram…
Analyze.title: Histogram (and statistics) of every slice and frame of the current channel, within the selection.

Analyze.label: Multi Measure (ROI Manager)…
Analyze.title: Measure every ROI of the ROI Manager on every slice / frame of the current channel (ROI Manager ▸ Multi Measure).

Analyze.label: Labels… (ROI names / values as overlay)…
Analyze.title: Add a text overlay item to every ROI-Manager ROI (or the selection, or every ROI-shaped overlay item) showing its index, name, a measurement or the pixel value, with ImageJ's Overlay ▸ Labels… options (use names, font size, bold, colour, background, centroid / bounding box). Labels of ROIs pinned to a plane stay on that plane.

Help.label: About Plugins
Help.title: List every loaded command module (built-in and ~/.lumen/plugins) with its command count, plus modules that failed to import.

Help.label: Lumen / ImageJ Links
Help.title: A table of documentation links for Lumen, ImageJ, Fiji and the Python imaging stack.

Help.label: Command Help…
Help.title: Describe a command: its id, menu, kind, shortcut and a table of its parameters with types, defaults and choices.

Help.label: Check for Updates…
Help.title: Compare the running Lumen version with the source tree's pyproject.toml and, when the network is allowed, with the latest lumen-imaging release on PyPI. Nothing is installed: upgrade with `pip install -U lumen-imaging` (or `git pull` in a checkout).

Help.label: Update Lumen…
Help.title: Update the running Lumen in place: `git pull --ff-only` in a git checkout, `python -m pip install --upgrade lumen-imaging` for a package install (a plain source folder without git cannot be updated automatically). The command's output goes to the Log and an 'Update' table. The server is never restarted – restart `lumen` afterwards to run the new version (ImageJ's Help ▸ Update ImageJ… / Fiji's Update…).

hint:Display: Display changes never modify pixel values. Use Apply LUT / RGB Color to bake them in.
hint:Threshold: Red pixels are inside the range. Drag the handles, or pick a method and press Auto. Local (adaptive) methods: ⌘K → “Auto Local Threshold”.
hint:3-D View: 256 × 256 × 60 voxels · z/xy 1.12 · Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, ⇧-drag / right-drag to pan, double-click to reset.
hint:Orthogonal Views: Sections through the image centre; draw a point or area selection to move them. Click or drag in a section to change the current slice. Z is
hint:ROI Manager: Click to select, ⇧/⌘-click for multiple, double-click to rename. Selecting a ROI jumps to its slice.
hint:Pixel Classifier: Traces are ROI-manager entries named class:<name> on the plane they were drawn on. Weka loop: trace → Train → look at the overlay → add trac
hint:History: No changes yet. Every applied command can be undone.
